observation_scope: Historical observations from the completed source review; current validation only checks included factual records.

observations.observation: Historical full-map review supports generalized Montreal and Wapawekka identities. The third complete ring reaches separately labelled Wood/Mirond waters and unassigned intervening extent.
The letter-D station index contains none of the three target names. It supplies no corroboration for these findings.

The original publications and inspection materials are not included. Offline validation checks the included records and geometry; it does not reopen those publications or reproduce visual map judgments.
